# PR #151 correctness review

## A. Verdict

**block** at `5911936acb9a20dec676dc9a43a2e87625d0902d`.

One small closeout-accounting repair is owed. The supplied ordinary validation receipt is accurate, but complete validation is not green.

## B. Scope

Six changed files, all under `docs/plans/209-fleet-followups/`: three DD sources and their generated views. No product-code rereview or performance reassessment.

## C. Accepted changes

#144 is merged as `e6958e71a1b3ffe2b3dfa38d49ae16be04a1401c`, from reviewed head `165c32215126ed72e5eb8949431f090cde50d559`. The recorded reviewer/security/performance outputs at that full head exist and are all pass-with-notes, from the writers named in bp-0008.

The after-deploy note exists and matches bp-0007's numbers: 43 launches / 60.007030 seconds = 0.716583/s, compared descriptively with 0.70/s BEFORE; CPU 16.70%, RSS 142.73 to 143.91 MiB. Preserve its qualification: this was an active-fleet observation, not a controlled idle baseline or causal regression test. Machine-wide increase is not attributed to #144.

The bp-0016 correction accurately states that doctests compile during the run and `--doc` uses one run-only invocation. **#144 N003 is closed.** Source/view changes agree; the regenerated task table's removed column held only empty values.

## D. F001: shipped plan retains an unclaimed acceptance criterion

**P2, `docs/plans/209-fleet-followups/assets/tasks/phase-1/tasks.dd.json:126-128`.**

tk-0009 is now checked, but its `satisfies` lists only ac-0007. No task accounts for newly checked ac-0008. The plan and phase are marked shipped/checked without complete per-criterion accounting.

Read-only validation at the unchanged full head returned:

```text
harness plan validate docs/plans/209-fleet-followups
  status: ok; mode: summary; errors: 0; warnings: 0; open: 0; orphans: 1

harness plan validate docs/plans/209-fleet-followups --complete
  status: degraded; errors: 0; warnings: 1; open: 0; orphans: 1
  orphan-claim: plan.dd.json#acceptance_criteria/ac-0008
  "has no incoming satisfies — no task accounts for it"
```

The plain result does not contradict the supplied receipt: summary mode does not surface this warning. It does not prove complete closeout either.

**Repair:** add ac-0008 to tk-0009's `satisfies` through ddocs, regenerate the view, and require `harness plan validate ... --complete` to return zero errors and warnings before retaining shipped status. No behavioral repair is requested.

## E. CI

[CI run 42352834657](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42352834657) completed successfully at this full head, all four jobs green. [Delivers run 42352834688](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42352834688) also passed. PR state is CLEAN.

## F. Cost and limits

Docs only; no loop, timer or launch changed. Receipts were checked against governance outputs, not reproduced with live fleet probes. No local builds or tests.

## G. Commands

Exact-head diff and merge metadata; governance receipt reads; clean pinned checkout inspected before and after ordinary/complete read-only plan validation; exact-head CI checks.

## H. Handover and harness feedback

Return a frozen repaired head with the missing accounting edge and a zero-warning complete-validation receipt. **magicWand:** use `--complete` for closeout; ordinary summary green can coexist with unclaimed criteria.
